title: Yellowed Savory Mexican Pork Knuckle Pie
description: A dense and festive Mexican dish featuring pork knuckle in a savory pie, inspired by the flavors of Veracruz, and kosher-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large Dutch oven, brown the pork knuckle over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic, ground cumin, smoked paprika, kosher salt, and freshly ground black pepper to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the veracruz tomato sauce and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 2 hours, or until the pork is tender.
On a lightly floured surface, roll out the pie crust to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Spoon the pork mixture into the center of the pie crust, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Brush the edges of the pie crust with the beaten egg and fold the crust over the filling, pressing the edges to seal.
Use a knife to cut a few slits in the top of the pie crust and brush the top with the remaining beaten egg.
